title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Parking - ParkingSpotsByVehicleType
description: Group of parking spots for each type of vehicle: cars, motorcycles, bicycles, among others (edintapar:ParkingSpotsByVehicleType). Indicates the number of slots per vehicle type. NOTE: the source ontology declares no rdfs:domain at all for its 'vehicleType' property; assigned to this entity per the property's own name/comment (mirroring the equally-evident, but differently-broken, permitType situation on ParkingSpotsByPermitType); see standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ParkingSpotsByVehicleType'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

hasParkingSpot.description: Relationship. The individual ParkingSpot(s) in this group (edintapar:hasParkingSpot).

numberOfParkingSpots.description: Property. Number of parking spots for this vehicle type (edintapar:numberOfParkingSpots).

vehicleType.description: Property. The vehicle type this group of spots is reserved for, reusing edint-censo-vehiculos's VehicleType controlled vocabulary (same kos/edint/VehicleType concept scheme referenced by both ontologies).
